named-stores: two stores in one project, searched together.

A "default" store for notes and an "adr" store for decisions. --store picks the store to work
on, an alias in kb.toml gives a store a second name, and --stores fans a search out over
several. A hit from another store shows as REF:path and kb show REF:path reads it.

  $ kb init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb init --name adr --model fake:8
  created store "adr" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  added data/tmux.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb --store adr add $WORK/notes/adr-cache.md
  added data-adr/adr-cache.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb stores
  STORE      MODEL   ENTRIES  DATABASE
  adr        fake:8  1        (size)
  default *  fake:8  1        (size)

Name the adr store a second way, with an alias in the location's kb.toml.

  $ write .kb/kb.toml @kbtoml

  $ kb stores
  STORE      MODEL   ENTRIES  DATABASE
  adr        fake:8  1        (size)
  default *  fake:8  1        (size)

  aliases:
    decisions  adr  -> adr@$WORK/proj

  $ kb search "cache invalidation" --mode fts --caller claude --stores decisions
  search 1 · 2 hits
  [1] decisions:data-adr/adr-cache.md · updated 2026-02-02
  ADR 7 cache invalidation: We invalidate the cache on write.

  [2] decisions:data-adr/adr-cache.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-02
  ADR 7 cache invalidation › (intro)
  # ADR 7 cache invalidation

  Decision: cache invalidation happens on every write, not on a timer.
  search_id=1

  $ kb show decisions:data-adr/adr-cache.md
  ---
  title: ADR 7 cache invalidation
  summary: We invalidate the cache on write.
  tags: [adr]
  updated: 2026-02-02
  ---
  # ADR 7 cache invalidation

  Decision: cache invalidation happens on every write, not on a timer.

  $ kb feedback --last 1 --useful --caller claude
  recorded: search 1 rank 1 useful=1 (newest search for claude, (time): "cache invalidation")

  $ kb stats overview --json
  {
    "query": "overview",

Other ways to name the stores: all, an empty list (this store only), a store that is not there.

  $ kb search "cache invalidation" --mode fts --caller claude --stores all
  search 2 · 2 hits
  [1] adr:data-adr/adr-cache.md · updated 2026-02-02
  ADR 7 cache invalidation: We invalidate the cache on write.

  [2] adr:data-adr/adr-cache.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-02
  ADR 7 cache invalidation › (intro)
  # ADR 7 cache invalidation

  Decision: cache invalidation happens on every write, not on a timer.
  search_id=2

  $ kb search "cache invalidation" --mode fts --caller claude --stores ''
  search 3 · 0 hits
  no results
  search_id=3

  $ kb search "cache invalidation" --mode fts --caller claude --stores nope
  search 4 · 0 hits
  no results
  search_id=4
  [stderr] warning: skipping store nope: no store "nope" in $WORK/proj and no alias of that name (stores: adr, default; aliases: decisions); create a store with kb init --name nope

  $ kb --store nope list
  [stderr] kb list: no store "nope" in $WORK/proj and no alias of that name (stores: adr, default; aliases: decisions); create a store with kb init --name nope
  [exit 1]

-- notes/tmux.md --
---
title: Tmux survives logout
summary: Keep sessions alive after you log out of the remote host.
tags: [ops]
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Tmux survives logout

Start tmux on the remote host and detach. The session keeps running on the host.
